def rollover(self):
        """Roll the buffer over to a TempFile"""
        if not self._rolled:
            tmp = EncodedFile(TemporaryFile(dir=self._dir),
                              data_encoding='utf-8')
            pos = self.buffer.tell()
            tmp.write(self.buffer.getvalue())
            tmp.seek(pos)
            self.buffer.close()
            self._buffer = tmp
